headline: Dallas Baptist beat UCCS again to close the calendar
dek: Dallas Baptist, who had won away at both Regis and UCCS in September, beat UCCS again on their own ground in the last match on the calendar. UCCS end the season with five defeats, the first and the last of them to Dallas Baptist.
